description: The bar chart illustrates the number of datasets related to hateful communication, categorized by whether they are targeted or untargeted, across the years 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the year, while the vertical axis indicates the number of datasets, ranging from 0 to 160. Each year is represented by a stacked bar, with the lower portion in blue representing untargeted datasets and the upper portion in orange representing targeted datasets. In 2012, there was one untargeted dataset and one targeted dataset. The number of datasets remained low until 2016, when one untargeted and one targeted dataset were recorded. From 2017 onwards, the number of datasets increased significantly. In 2017, there were two untargeted and two targeted datasets. In 2018, there were three untargeted and three targeted datasets. In 2019, there were four untargeted and four targeted datasets. In 2020, there were five untargeted and five targeted datasets. In 2021, there were six untargeted and six targeted datasets. In 2022, there were seven untargeted and seven targeted datasets. The chart shows a consistent increase in the number of datasets over the years, with the number of targeted datasets consistently higher than the number of untargeted datasets.
